items.title: 美光HBM產能拚翻倍 投資人大利多來了？
items.title_en: Micron's HBM Capacity Set to Double – A Major Boost for Investors?
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)與其他記憶體廠商必須在滿足客戶需求與避免產品供過於求之間取得微妙平衡，否則一旦記憶體市場轉差，可能面臨產能過剩的問題。
不過，在目前供應極度吃緊情況下，一名分析師認為，美光大幅提高產能將帶來「龐大機會」，公司有望從強勁需求中獲利。而一份最新報導顯示，美光似乎正朝這個方向前進。
據南韓新聞網站《Electronic Times》報導，美光據稱正投入資金，計劃在今年底前將高頻寬記憶體(HBM)產能提高一倍。
報導指出，美光希望追上南韓SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)與三星電子(Samsung Electronics)的產能，以改善12層HBM4的供應。這是最新一代HBM產品，將用於輝達的Rubin GPU等晶片。HBM是透過堆疊動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)晶片製成，而美光、SK海力士與三星電子都是全球主要DRAM供應商。
J.Gold Associates分析師Jack Gold指出，像美光這類記憶體廠商多年來一直「困在相對低成本的標準型記憶體製造」領域。如今，HBM這類高階產品的需求「幾乎無止境」，「這為供應商帶來重大機會，可以從中獲取可觀利潤，因為產品的利潤率相當高。」
《Electronic Times》報導，美光去年HBM月產量約為4萬至5萬片晶圓。這意味著，若按照目前傳出的計畫，每月增加6萬片晶圓產能，年底HBM月產能可能達到約10萬片。
不同於一般用途的DRAM，HBM是一種專用型記憶體，速度更快、能源效率也更高，因此非常適合人工智慧應用。這些優勢也讓記憶體廠商能夠為HBM產品收取更高價格。
美光股價也因此大幅飆升，周五收漲6.1%，今年以來累計上漲256%。
同時，AI驅動的需求也造成DRAM及其他類型記憶體與儲存產品嚴重短缺，進而擠壓消費電子等其他市場。Gold指出，儘管美光、SK海力士與三星電子都已宣布擴建更多晶圓廠產能，但整個過程仍需要數年時間。
因此，三家公司都開始將現有產能從低成本記憶體轉向HBM，Gold表示，這也進一步加劇了整體記憶體供應吃緊的情況。
Gold表示，「傳統上，記憶體短缺不會永遠持續，而記憶體廠商希望在市場周期再次轉向供過於求之前，盡可能把握這波行情帶來的好處。」
預計在可預見的未來，記憶體需求仍將遠遠超過供給。
D.A. Davidson總經理Gil Luria表示，目前需求「已經超過現有供給的兩倍，而且仍在快速成長」。因此，即使美光進一步提高HBM產能，在這段期間內「很可能仍不足以滿足市場需求」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Micron Technology (MU-US) and other memory makers must strike a delicate balance between meeting customer demand and avoiding oversupply, because a market downturn could leave them with excess capacity.

However, with supply currently extremely tight, an analyst says Micron’s aggressive capacity expansion creates a "huge opportunity" and the company could profit from strong demand, and a recent report suggests Micron is moving in that direction.
According to South Korean news site Electronic Times, Micron is reportedly investing money to double its high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity by the end of this year.

The report notes Micron wants to catch up with South Korea’s SK Hynix (SKHY-US) and Samsung Electronics in capacity to improve supply of 12‑layer HBM4, the latest‑generation HBM that will be used in Nvidia’s Rubin GPU and other chips. HBM is built by stacking DRAM dies, and Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung are the world’s major DRAM suppliers.

J. Gold Associates analyst Jack Gold points out that memory makers like Micron have been "stuck in relatively low‑cost standard‑memory manufacturing" for years. Now demand for high‑end products such as HBM is "almost limitless," offering suppliers a major chance to earn sizable profits because the product’s margins are very high.

Electronic Times reports Micron’s monthly HBM output last year was about 40,000‑50,000 wafers. That means, if the announced plan to add 60,000 wafers per month materializes, monthly HBM capacity could reach roughly 100,000 wafers by year‑end.

Unlike general‑purpose DRAM, HBM is a specialized memory that is faster and more energy‑efficient, making it ideal for AI applications. Those advantages also let memory makers charge a premium for HBM products.
Micron’s stock jumped sharply as a result, closing up 6.1% on Friday and up 256% so far this year.

At the same time, AI‑driven demand has caused severe shortages of DRAM and other memory and storage products, squeezing downstream markets such as consumer electronics. Gold notes that although Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung have all announced expansions of wafer‑fab capacity, the whole process will still take several years.
Consequently, all three companies are shifting existing capacity from low‑cost memory to HBM, which Gold says further tightens overall memory supply.
Gold adds, "Historically, memory shortages don’t last forever, and memory makers want to capture as much upside as possible before the market cycle swings back to oversupply."
In the foreseeable future, memory demand is expected to far outpace supply.

D.A. Davidson Managing Director Gil Luria says current demand "is already more than twice existing supply and is growing rapidly," so even if Micron raises HBM capacity further, it is "likely still insufficient to meet market demand" during this period.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉盟立大啖先進封裝商機 周漲11%創歷史新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Mingli Seizes Advanced Packaging Opportunities, Rises 11% to Record High
paras: 自動化設備大廠盟立(2464-TW)近期受惠封測大廠積極擴充先進封裝產能，對自動化需求大增，推升盟立目前在手訂單超過150億元，加上在機器人的布局，獲外界肯定，吸引資金進駐，推升本周股價一度衝上224元、改寫歷史新高價，終場收在211元，周漲11.34%。
盟立今年在SEMICON TAIWAN 2026以 「AI in Motion / AI 機器人新動能」 為主軸，大秀整合先進封裝搬運、智動化系統到人形機器人的全方位解決方案。
盟立7月營收8.63億元，月增6.2%，年增62.1%，創下34個月新高，累計前7月營收48.96億元，年增25.6%。受惠半導體自動化需求大爆發，盟立現階段在手訂單上看150億元，預期2026年全年營收有望站回百億元大關，營運可望顯著優於去年。
盟立本周在買盤加持下衝破前高，週五最高達224元，創下歷史新高，但受高檔獲利了結賣壓影響，終場收在211元，單周仍大漲11.34%，三大法人本周全站買方，外資狂掃11,072張，投信與自營商也分別敲進452張、413張。
paras_en: Automation equipment giant Mingli (2464-TW) recently benefited from major packaging test manufacturers actively expanding advanced packaging capacity, leading to a surge in automation demand, pushing Mingli's current order backlog to over NT$15 billion. Combined with its robotics layout, it has gained external recognition, attracting capital inflows, lifting the stock price this week to as high as NT$224, setting a new all‑time high, and closing at NT$211, up 11.34% for the week.

This year Mingli showcased at SEMICON TAIWAN 2026 with the theme “AI in Motion / AI Robotics New Momentum”, presenting a full‑range solution that integrates advanced packaging handling, intelligent automation systems and humanoid robots.

Mingli posted July revenue of NT$8.63 billion, up 6.2% month‑over‑month and 62.1% year‑over‑year, a 34‑month high. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$48.96 billion, up 25.6% YoY. Benefiting from a boom in semiconductor automation demand, Mingli’s current order backlog stands at NT$15 billion, and it expects full‑year 2026 revenue to return to the NT$100 billion level, with operating performance likely to be significantly better than last year.

This week, backed by buying pressure, Mingli broke its previous high, reaching a peak of NT$224 on Friday, a historic high, but was pulled down by profit‑taking selling pressure at higher levels, closing at NT$211. The stock still surged 11.34% for the week. All three major institutional investors were net buyers this week: foreign investors snapped up 11,072 lots, while investment trusts and proprietary traders bought 452 lots and 413 lots respectively.

items.title: Anthropic IPO延後！招股書最快9月底亮相 10月中旬啟動推介 估值上看2兆美元
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Delayed! Prospectus Expected by Late September, Roadshow to Start Mid-October, Valuation Seen at $2 Trillion
paras: 人工智慧公司Anthropic的超大型首次公開募股(IPO)計畫出現時間調整。知情人士透露，Anthropic最快將於10月中旬啟動IPO推介，並可能在11月美國中期選舉前幾天完成上市；原本預計最快下周公布的IPO招股說明書，現在則可能延至9月下旬才會亮相。知情人士強調，上市時間表仍可能因市場環境、監管審查及籌備進度而變動。
Anthropic是Claude聊天機器人的開發商，也是目前全球最受矚目的生成式人工智慧企業之一。按照目前規畫，公司可能尋求募資超過1000億美元，並以約2兆美元估值進入公開市場。若最終達成，將超越今年6月SpaceX上市時募資857億美元、估值約1.77兆美元的紀錄，成為史上規模最大的IPO之一，甚至可能改寫全球IPO募資及企業估值紀錄。

這場IPO的時間點原本明顯更為激進。知情人士先前透露，Anthropic預計最快在9月初公開招股說明書，作為進入上市最後階段的關鍵文件，但最新計畫已調整至9月下旬。按照目前安排，公司可能在10月中旬開始正式向投資人推介股票，並在11月美國中期選舉前後完成上市。路透指出，由於Anthropic已受到分析師高度關注，傳統IPO流程中分析師會議與公開提交招股說明書之間通常相隔數周的時間，此次兩個階段之間的窗口可能會被壓縮。
在上市準備方面，Anthropic也正尋求敲定150億美元循環信貸額度。知情人士表示，相關融資完成後，包括參與此次融資的銀行分析師在內的分析師預計將與Anthropic管理層會面，為後續IPO推介及定價工作做準備。
目前參與IPO籌備工作的主要金融機構包括摩根士丹利(MS-US)、高盛(GS-US)、摩根大通(JPM-US)及花旗集團(C-US)。最新消息顯示，摩根士丹利及高盛可能在此次IPO中扮演更重要的主導角色，而摩根大通、花旗及其他銀行則因先前參與Anthropic債務融資而具有合作基礎。
Anthropic之所以能夠挑戰2兆美元估值，關鍵在於近幾個月營收呈現爆發式成長。根據Anthropic向投資人提供的最新數據，截至7月底，公司年化營收(run-rate revenue)已突破650億美元，遠高於今年5月約470億美元，較兩個月前增加約38%，同時較2025年底約90億美元的水準成長逾7倍。
這項650億美元年化營收數據也意味著Anthropic的商業化速度正在快速加快。公司今年5月完成新一輪650億美元融資時，官方公布的公司投後估值已達9650億美元，當時Anthropic表示年化營收在5月初已突破470億美元。
季度營收同樣呈現驚人增長。Anthropic今年第二季初步營收超過115億美元，相較2025年同期的7.87億美元至少成長14倍，也高於今年第一季的47.3億美元。文件顯示，公司第二季還錄得正的調整後營業利益，代表Anthropic不僅營收高速成長，獲利能力也開始出現改善跡象。不過相關數字仍屬初步數據，後續可能調整。
若以年化營收650億美元計算，Anthropic目前的營收規模已經使其成為全球AI產業最具商業價值的企業之一。市場也因此開始將Anthropic與OpenAI直接比較。OpenAI目前年化營收約400億美元，較2025年底的200億美元翻倍；不過兩家公司對年化營收的計算方式可能存在差異，因此相關數據並非完全可直接比較。
Anthropic對未來營收的預期則更加激進。知情人士此前透露，公司內部預估2028年營收可能達到1900億至2000億美元，若這一目標最終實現，將意味著Anthropic未來兩年仍需要維持極高的成長速度，也將成為支撐2兆美元IPO估值的重要依據。
Anthropic目前仍是一家未上市企業，但其估值已經快速逼近全球最大科技公司的行列。今年5月完成650億美元H輪融資後，公司投後估值達9650億美元。這輪融資由Altimeter Capital、Dragoneer、Greenoaks及紅杉資本等投資人領投，資金主要用於擴大運算能力、推進AI安全及可解釋性研究，以及擴大Claude等產品與合作夥伴關係。
Anthropic的核心產品Claude近年在企業市場快速擴張，尤其在程式開發、知識工作及企業AI應用方面取得大量客戶。公司希望藉由擴大模型能力及運算基礎設施，把AI服務需求轉化為更大規模的企業訂閱及API收入，這也是目前投資人願意給予高估值的重要原因。
不過，2兆美元估值同樣意味著Anthropic必須面對非常高的市場期待。即使650億美元年化營收相當可觀，2兆美元估值仍代表投資人需要預期未來營收持續高速成長，而且利潤率必須同步提升。部分市場分析也認為，AI企業目前的估值已經包含大量未來成長預期，因此IPO後股價可能對營收成長速度、資本支出及獲利能力高度敏感。
另一方面，Anthropic並非唯一正在準備上市的AI巨頭。OpenAI同樣已提交機密IPO文件，市場普遍預期其可能在Anthropic之後進入公開市場。如果兩家公司相繼上市，將使公開市場首次有機會直接比較兩大頂級生成式AI公司的營收、成長速度、資本需求及估值水準。
SpaceX今年6月的上市則已為超大型科技IPO建立新的基準。SpaceX當時募資約857億美元，上市估值約1.77兆美元，已創下全球最大IPO募資規模之一。若Anthropic最終按照超過1000億美元募資及2兆美元估值的目標完成交易，將進一步把AI企業推向全球資本市場的核心位置。
此外，市場對Anthropic IPO的期待也已開始催生衍生投資產品。包括Direxion、Tradr、Leverage Shares及GraniteShares等基金公司據報正規畫推出與Anthropic股票掛鉤的槓桿型單一股票ETF，顯示即使Anthropic尚未正式上市，市場已經提前為其股票交易及波動做好準備。
對Anthropic而言，接下來最關鍵的里程碑將是9月下旬是否正式公布IPO招股說明書，以及公司能否在10月中旬啟動推介並於11月中期選舉前完成上市。若進度順利，Anthropic將成為今年全球資本市場最受矚目的新股之一；若最終募資突破1000億美元並達到2兆美元估值，則不僅將刷新SpaceX創下的紀錄，也將成為投資人評估AI產業長期商業價值的一場關鍵市場測試。
paras_en: AI company Anthropic's mega initial public offering (IPO) plan has been rescheduled. Insiders say the IPO roadshow could start as early as mid‑October and the listing might be completed a few days before the U.S. midterm elections in November; the prospectus that was originally slated for release next week may now not appear until late September. Insiders stress that the timeline could still shift due to market conditions, regulatory review and preparation progress.

Anthropic, the developer of the Claude chatbot, is one of the most watched generative AI firms worldwide. Under current plans the company may seek to raise more than $100 billion and enter the public market with a valuation of roughly $2 trillion. If achieved, it would surpass SpaceX’s June‑2024 IPO, which raised $85.7 billion at a valuation of about $1.77 trillion, becoming one of the largest IPOs ever and potentially rewriting global IPO fundraising and valuation records.

The IPO timing was originally far more aggressive. Insiders previously indicated that Anthropic expected to publish its prospectus in early September as the key document for the final listing stage, but the latest plan pushes that to late September. According to the current schedule the company could begin formally pitching its shares to investors in mid‑October and complete the listing around the November U.S. midterms. Reuters notes that because Anthropic is already drawing heavy analyst attention, the usual weeks‑long gap between analyst meetings and the public filing of the prospectus may be compressed this time.

In preparation for the listing, Anthropic is also seeking to finalize a $15 billion revolving credit facility. Insiders say that once that financing is in place, analysts—including those from the banks participating in the financing—are expected to meet with Anthropic’s management to prepare for the roadshow and pricing work.

The main financial institutions working on the IPO include Morgan Stanley (MS‑US), Goldman Sachs (GS‑US), JPMorgan (JPM‑US) and Citigroup (C‑US). The latest information shows Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs may take a more leading role in the IPO, while JPMorgan, Citigroup and other banks have a collaborative foundation from their prior involvement in Anthropic’s debt financing.

Anthropic’s ability to target a $2 trillion valuation hinges on explosive revenue growth in recent months. According to the latest data provided to investors, the company’s annualized run‑rate revenue had topped $65 billion by the end of July, far above the roughly $47 billion reported in May, a 38% increase over two months and more than seven‑fold growth from the about $9 billion level at the end of 2025.

That $65 billion annualized revenue figure also signals a rapid acceleration of commercialization. When Anthropic closed a new $65 billion financing round in May, the post‑money valuation disclosed was $965 billion, and the company said its annualized revenue had already broken $47 billion in early May.

Quarterly revenue is likewise soaring. Anthropic’s preliminary second‑quarter revenue this year exceeded $11.5 billion, at least 14‑times the $787 million recorded for the same quarter in 2025 and higher than the $4.73 billion posted in the first quarter. The filing shows the company also recorded positive adjusted operating income in Q2, indicating that profit margins are beginning to improve alongside the revenue surge. The numbers are still preliminary and may be revised later.

Based on a $65 billion annual run‑rate, Anthropic’s revenue size already makes it one of the most commercially valuable AI firms globally. The market is therefore beginning to compare Anthropic directly with OpenAI. OpenAI’s annualized revenue is currently about $40 billion, roughly double its $20 billion level at the end of 2025; however, the two companies may calculate annualized revenue differently, so the figures are not perfectly comparable.

Anthropic’s outlook for future revenue is even more aggressive. Insiders previously disclosed that internal forecasts project 2028 revenue of $190 billion to $200 billion. If that target is met, Anthropic would need to sustain an extremely high growth rate over the next two years, providing a key justification for a $2 trillion IPO valuation.

Anthropic remains a private company, but its valuation is rapidly approaching that of the world’s largest tech firms. After completing a $65 billion Series H round in May, the post‑money valuation reached $965 billion. The round was led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, with funds earmarked for expanding compute capacity, advancing AI safety and interpretability research, and growing Claude and other product and partnership initiatives.

Claude, Anthropic’s flagship product, has been expanding quickly in the enterprise market, especially in software development, knowledge work and corporate AI applications, attracting many customers. The company aims to translate larger model capabilities and compute infrastructure into bigger enterprise subscription and API revenues, a major reason investors are willing to assign a high valuation.

Nevertheless, a $2 trillion valuation also means Anthropic must meet very high market expectations. Even with a sizable $65 billion annualized revenue, a $2 trillion market cap implies investors expect continued rapid revenue growth and rising profit margins. Some analysts argue that AI company valuations already embed substantial future growth assumptions, so the post‑IPO share price could be highly sensitive to revenue growth pace, capital spending and profitability.

Anthropic is not the only AI giant preparing for an IPO. OpenAI has also filed confidential IPO paperwork, and the market generally expects it could go public after Anthropic. If both firms list in succession, the public markets would get the first chance to directly compare the revenue, growth rates, capital needs and valuation levels of the two leading generative‑AI companies.

SpaceX’s June IPO set a new benchmark for mega‑tech listings. At that time SpaceX raised about $85.7 billion and was valued at roughly $1.77 trillion, creating one of the largest IPO fundraising totals globally. If Anthropic ultimately raises over $100 billion and completes the deal at a $2 trillion valuation, it would push AI firms further into the core of the global capital markets.

Moreover, market anticipation of the Anthropic IPO is already spawning derivative investment products. Funds such as Direxion, Tradr, Leverage Shares and GraniteShares are reportedly planning leveraged single‑stock ETFs linked to Anthropic’s shares, showing that even before a formal listing the market is preparing for trading and volatility.

For Anthropic, the most critical milestones ahead are whether the prospectus is formally released in late September, whether the roadshow can start in mid‑October and whether the listing can be completed before the November midterm elections. If the timeline holds, Anthropic will be one of the most watched new issues of the year; if it ultimately raises more than $100 billion at a $2 trillion valuation, it will not only break SpaceX’s record but also serve as a pivotal market test for investors assessing the long‑term commercial value of the AI industry.

items.title_en: Wall Street Bets on Paul Volcker to Stabilize the Bond Market Amid September Corporate Bond Issuance Surge
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美債市場近期劇烈震盪，加上科技巨頭為人工智慧基礎建設籌措龐大資金，企業債發行即將加速。華爾街正寄望聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許維持市場信心，避免31.5兆美元的美債市場進一步失序。
美國長天期公債殖利率今夏持續攀升，指標殖利率本週一度觸及川普第二任期以來新高。市場壓力可能很快加劇，因為美國9月投資級公司債發行規模估達2,000億美元，資金需求將與美國政府龐大舉債正面競爭。
渣打銀行美國暨美洲市場主管Thomas Kikis 表示，從勞動節到耶誕節期間，市場可能變得極度忙亂。除了大量企業債供給，經歷一個令人不安的夏季後，市場也可能迎來更多大型首次公開募股 (IPO)。
他強調，面對債券發行與潛在IPO接連湧現，市場現在最需要的是「穩定與信任」。
華爾街寄望華許穩定市場信心
美國財長貝森特近期試圖透過干預措施安撫公債市場，但目前效果有限。相較之下，華許在傑克森霍爾發表演說後，市場逐漸相信他能成為穩定債市的力量。
隨著企業加速發債籌資，延續這份信任將格外重要。德意志銀行全球總體研究主管芮德 (Jim Reid) 預測，今年美國投資級公司債淨供給量將創歷史新高，略高於2020年疫情期間的再融資高峰。
較正面的因素是，投資級債券基金持續吸引大量資金流入，有助市場消化新增供給，也可能使目前處於歷史低檔的公司債信用利差維持穩定。
企業債殖利率由美債殖利率加上信用利差構成。近期美國長天期公債殖利率約落在4.75%至5.25%，Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 8月發行的30年期公司債，利率則接近6.4%。
AI競賽推升企業融資需求
AI建設成本已成為金融市場的重要考驗。預估2027年相關資本支出將接近1.1兆美元，而且到2030年仍有進一步增加空間。
亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Alphabet、Meta (META-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 等超大規模雲端服務商，需要投入數十億美元維持AI競爭力。Anthropic與OpenAI也預計繼SpaceX (SPCX-US) 今年6月上市後，分別於2026年及2027年進行IPO。
政府與科技企業同時爭奪市場資金，形成債券投資人關注的「排擠效應」。美國政府因龐大財政赤字而有高度融資需求，科技巨頭也需要持續發債，為AI基礎建設籌資。
貝森特上月宣布介入公債市場時曾指出，參與AI建設的超大規模企業並不太在意融資成本，顯示相關公司即使面對高利率，仍可能繼續舉債投資。
美債利息支出每年達1兆美元
市場對AI熱潮的長期影響仍有分歧，投資人尚未形成共識，無法確定AI最終將推動美國經濟轉型、引發市場崩跌，或兩者先後發生。
富國銀行投資研究院估計，AI目前占美國經濟成長比重已超過40%，這波建設規模也已超越美國過去興建鐵路、公路及網際網路基礎設施的投資熱潮。
Fed理事華勒表示傾向反對9月升息後，美國10年期公債殖利率週四略為回落，但約4.75%的水準仍接近2025年1月以來高點。
根據美國財政部資料，債務規模擴大與殖利率居高不下，已使美國政府每年利息支出達1兆美元，超過醫療保健或國防支出。
富國銀行分析師認為，AI本身不足以解決美國財政問題，但若能提高生產力，仍可能在一定程度上緩解市場對財政前景的疑慮。
Kikis表示，未來幾週的關鍵在於政府能否在企業債發行高峰到來時維持市場穩定。9月與10月的市場表現，將顯示美國公債與公司債是否有足夠空間，同時消化兩方面的龐大融資需求。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that the U.S. Treasury market has been highly volatile recently, and with tech giants raising massive funds for AI infrastructure, corporate bond issuance is set to accelerate. Wall Street is hoping Fed Chair Paul Volcker will maintain market confidence and prevent the $31.5 trillion Treasury market from further disorder.

U.S. long‑term Treasury yields have continued to climb this summer, hitting a new high for the first time since Trump’s second term. Market pressure may soon intensify, as September 2024 corporate bond issuance is estimated at $200 billion, competing directly with the U.S. government’s large borrowing needs.

Thomas Kikis, head of Standard Chartered’s U.S. and Americas markets, said the market could become extremely hectic from Labor Day to Christmas. In addition to a large corporate bond supply, the market may also see more large IPOs after a worrying summer.
He emphasized that with bonds and potential IPOs flooding in, the market now needs “stability and trust.”
Wall Street is hoping Volcker will stabilize market confidence.

Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has recently tried to calm the Treasury market with intervention measures, but the effect has been limited. In contrast, after Volcker’s speech at Jackson Hole, the market gradually began to believe he could be a stabilizing force for the bond market.

As companies accelerate bond issuance, maintaining this trust will be especially important. Jim Reid, head of Deutsche Bank’s global macro research, predicts that U.S. investment‑grade corporate bond net supply will reach a historic high this year, slightly above the refinancing peak during the 2020 pandemic.

A more positive factor is that investment‑grade bond funds continue to attract large inflows, helping the market absorb new supply and possibly keeping the currently historically low corporate bond credit spread stable.

Corporate bond yields are composed of Treasury yields plus credit spreads. Recently, U.S. long‑term Treasury yields have hovered around 4.75% to 5.25%, while Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) 30‑year corporate bond issued in August had a yield close to 6.4%.
AI competition drives corporate financing demand.
The cost of AI construction has become a major test for financial markets. Capital expenditures related to AI are expected to approach $1.1 trillion by 2027, with further growth potential by 2030.

Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet, Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), and Oracle (ORCL‑US) are among the mega‑cloud providers that need to invest billions to maintain AI competitiveness. Anthropic and OpenAI also plan to go public in 2026 and 2027, respectively, after SpaceX (SPCX‑US) went public in June this year.

Governments and tech firms are competing for market capital, creating a “crowding out” effect that attracts bond investors. The U.S. government has high financing needs due to a large fiscal deficit, and tech giants also need to continue issuing bonds to fund AI infrastructure.

When Yellen announced Treasury market intervention last month, she noted that mega‑scale enterprises involved in AI construction do not care much about financing costs, indicating that such companies may continue to borrow even in a high‑rate environment.
U.S. Treasury interest payments reach $1 trillion annually.

There is still disagreement among investors about the long‑term impact of the AI boom; consensus has not formed on whether AI will ultimately drive U.S. economic transformation, trigger a market crash, or which comes first.

Wells Fargo’s investment research estimated that AI currently accounts for over 40% of U.S. economic growth, and this construction scale has already surpassed past investment booms in railroads, highways, and the internet.

Fed Governor William Waller expressed a tendency to oppose a September rate hike; U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields fell slightly on Thursday but remain near the high point since January 2025 at about 4.75%.
According to U.S. Treasury data, the expanding debt and high yields have pushed the government’s annual interest payments to $1 trillion, exceeding healthcare or defense spending.
Wells Fargo analysts believe AI alone cannot solve U.S. fiscal problems, but if it boosts productivity, it could somewhat alleviate market concerns about fiscal prospects.

Kikis said the key in the coming weeks will be whether the government can maintain market stability as the corporate bond issuance peak approaches. The market performance in September and October will show whether U.S. Treasuries and corporate bonds have enough room to absorb the massive financing demand on both sides.

items.title: 繼iPhone Ultra或Fold後　蘋果折疊iPhone 突冒新名「iPhone Duo」
items.title_en: After iPhone Ultra or Fold, Apple’s folding iPhone suddenly gets new name “iPhone Duo”
paras: 蘋果首款折疊螢幕iPhone有望在下周正式亮相，這一備受期待的折疊版iPhone常被稱為iPhone Ultra或是iPhone Fold，不過現在又流傳出另一個名字：iPhone Duo。
目前沒有實據證明蘋果會採用iPhone Duo這一命名，但該命名確實存在可能性。過去，蘋果曾使用Duo品牌，如1990年代的PowerBook Duo系列筆電，以及2020年代初期推出的MagSafe雙充充電器，而此次Duo則意指折疊iPhone的雙螢幕設計。
今年4月，《Macworld》曾引述知情人士消息報導指出，折疊iPhone將命名為iPhone Ultra。《彭博資訊》知名科技記者古爾曼也表示，蘋果內部不少員工將折疊iPhone稱為iPhone Ultra，但從未篤定報導這會是設備的正式名稱。
蘋果已將Ultra命名用於Apple Watch Ultra、CarPlay Ultra，還有M1 Ultra、M2 Ultra、M3 Ultra以及M5 Ultra晶片。
但由於微軟曾在2020年推出一款雙螢幕Android手機Surface Duo，該機型現已停產，英特爾也曾在2000年代推出大受歡迎的酷睿Duo、酷睿2 Duo處理器。
受這些過往產品影響，蘋果也許會刻意避免Duo這項命名，不過其他競爭產品廠商同樣在使用Ultra、Fold命名，例如三星Galaxy S26 Ultra以及Galaxy Z Fold8。
paras_en: Apple’s first folding‑screen iPhone is expected to be officially unveiled next week. The highly anticipated folding iPhone has often been referred to as the iPhone Ultra or iPhone Fold, but a new name is now circulating: iPhone Duo.

There is currently no concrete evidence that Apple will adopt the iPhone Duo name, but the possibility does exist. Apple has used the Duo brand before, such as the PowerBook Duo series of laptops in the 1990s and the MagSafe dual‑charger introduced in the early 2020s, and this time Duo would refer to the folding iPhone’s dual‑screen design.

In April this year, Macworld quoted insiders reporting that the folding iPhone would be called iPhone Ultra. Bloomberg Technology reporter Mark Gurman also said many Apple employees refer to the folding iPhone as iPhone Ultra, though he never confirmed that it would be the official product name.
Apple has already used the Ultra designation for Apple Watch Ultra, CarPlay Ultra, as well as the M1 Ultra, M2 Ultra, M3 Ultra and M5 Ultra chips.
However, Microsoft launched a dual‑screen Android phone called Surface Duo in 2020, which has since been discontinued, and Intel released the popular Core Duo and Core 2 Duo processors in the 2000s.
Because of these past products, Apple may deliberately avoid the Duo name, but other competitors also use Ultra and Fold naming, such as Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold8.

items.title: 蘋果OLED MacBook Pro傳搭M5 Ultra晶片
items.title_en: Apple OLED MacBook Pro Rumored to Feature M5 Ultra Chip
paras: 《AppleInsider》報導，蘋果傳最快將於2026年底前推出OLED MacBook Pro。研究機構Omdia預測，這款新機除了升級螢幕，還「很可能」首度搭載M5 Ultra晶片。不過，考量功耗、散熱及蘋果過往的產品配置，這項預測仍存在不少疑點。
蘋果今年8月發表M5 Ultra，並率先應用於新款Mac Studio。這款晶片最高配備36核心CPU、80核心GPU，支援最高512GB統一記憶體。若導入MacBook Pro，將大幅提升筆電效能，也可能讓新機具備「MacBook Ultra」的產品定位。
然而，蘋果至今從未在筆電搭載Ultra系列晶片。MacBook Pro過去最高僅採用Max系列，Ultra晶片則用於桌上型Mac，背後考量主要與耗電量及散熱需求有關。因此，OLED MacBook Pro若採用M5 Ultra，不僅將打破既有產品策略，也需要重新處理筆電機身的電力與散熱限制。
以搭載Ultra晶片的Mac Studio為例，其散熱器比Max版本更加厚實，以因應晶片運作時產生的熱量。M5 Ultra若要充分發揮效能，同樣需要充足的電力與冷卻能力，但筆電有限的機身空間並不利於滿足這些條件。
蘋果自Intel處理器轉向自研M系列晶片後，已改善MacBook Pro在效能與能源效率之間的平衡，但仍無法完全擺脫筆電尺寸帶來的物理限制。目前也沒有證據顯示M5 Ultra採用可因應行動裝置的特殊設計。
外媒分析，Ultra晶片未來並非沒有進入MacBook產品線的可能，但Omdia是目前首度提出OLED MacBook Pro將搭載M5 Ultra的消息來源。在更多證據出現前，這項預測仍應審慎看待。
paras_en: AppleInsider reports that Apple may launch an OLED MacBook Pro as early as the end of 2026. Research firm Omdia predicts that the new machine will not only upgrade its display but also "likely" be the first to use the M5 Ultra chip. However, concerns about power consumption, heat dissipation, and Apple’s historical product configurations leave many doubts about this prediction.

Apple unveiled the M5 Ultra in August of this year, initially deploying it in the new Mac Studio. The chip can be configured with up to 36 CPU cores, 80 GPU cores, and supports up to 512 GB of unified memory. If incorporated into a MacBook Pro, it would dramatically boost laptop performance and could position the new device as a "MacBook Ultra."

Apple has never used an Ultra‑series chip in a laptop. The highest‑end MacBook Pro has only ever used Max‑series chips, while Ultra chips are reserved for desktop Macs, primarily due to power and cooling considerations. Therefore, an OLED MacBook Pro with an M5 Ultra would break existing product strategy and would require re‑engineering the laptop’s power and thermal limits.

Taking the Ultra‑chip Mac Studio as an example, its heatsink is thicker than that of the Max version to handle the heat generated during operation. The M5 Ultra would similarly need ample power and cooling to perform at its best, but the limited space in a laptop chassis makes meeting these requirements difficult.

Since switching from Intel processors to its own M‑series chips, Apple has improved the balance between performance and energy efficiency in the MacBook Pro, yet it still cannot fully overcome the physical constraints imposed by laptop size. There is currently no evidence that the M5 Ultra incorporates any special design for mobile devices.

Foreign analysts say that the Ultra chip may eventually enter the MacBook line, but Omdia is the first to suggest that an OLED MacBook Pro will use the M5 Ultra. Until more evidence emerges, this prediction should be treated with caution.

items.title: 美消費亮六大紅燈！沃爾瑪降溫、平價店崛起 傳奇經濟學家警告明年衰退機率70%
items.title_en: US Consumer Signals Six Red Flags! Walmart Cooling, Value Stores Rise; Legendary Economist Warns 70% Chance of Recession Next Year
paras: 曾準確預測網路泡沫與2008年房市危機聞名的史丹佛大學經濟學家Gary Shilling再度警告：美國消費者正頻頻亮起紅燈，種種跡象暗示，美國經濟未來一年可能陷入衰 退。
這位傳奇經濟學家本指出，美國經濟有一個特別令人擔憂的領域，就是消費者。由於能源成本維持高檔、利率可能居高不下，美國家庭正陸續出現警訊。
Shilling寫道：「消費者正在發出訊號，顯示經濟並非一切都很好。我們仍認為，未來一年出現衰退的機率為60%至70%。」
他補充說，不排除出現一段停滯性通膨時期，也就是「高通膨、高就業與經濟成長疲弱」並存的局面。
停滯性通膨(stagflationary)是經濟最糟糕的情境之一，指經濟成長放緩之際，通膨仍維持高檔。這種情況通常被認為比典型衰退更難處理，因為在一般衰退期間，聯準會(Fed)通常會透過降息提振經濟，但高通膨卻限縮了Fed透過降息刺激經濟的能力。
消費支出是美國經濟主要成長引擎，約占國民生產毛額(GDP)的三分之二。美國高收入族群目前仍持續消費，但市場擔心，中低收入家庭正受到多方面生活成本上升的壓力，開始縮減支出。
以下是Shilling觀察到的六大消費警訊：

1. 零售銷售大幅下滑

修正後的零售銷售數據顯示，美國民眾7月明顯縮減支出：根據美國人口普查局數據，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，創近一年來最大單月跌幅。
Shilling表示，「7月數據疲弱的一大因素，是聯邦退稅款的挹注效應正在消退。近幾個月這些退稅金可能並沒有大量用於非必要消費，而是花在價格更高、且無法避免的汽油與食品雜貨上。」

2. 消費者信心陷入低谷

消費者對經濟現況感到悲觀，8月的密大消費者信心指數出現三個月來首度下滑，指數也從2020年初的高峰大幅滑落。
有一部分悲觀情緒和通膨預期升高有關。根據密西根大學調查，8月受訪者對未來一年的通膨預期約為4%，高於2月、也就是伊朗戰爭爆發前的3.4%。
另外，根據Primerica第2季的調查，71%的中等收入美國人認為自己的財務狀況落後於生活成本的上升速度；59%則認為未來一年經濟狀況會惡化。

3. 消費者債務壓力不斷升高

根據Fed數據，截至第1季末，美國家庭與非營利組織的消費信貸負債已攀升到創紀錄的5.1兆美元。
Primerica調查顯示，32%的中等收入美國人表示，自己的信用卡債務在上季增加。
聲請破產的人數也在上升。Shilling表示，截至6月底的12個月期間，美國聲請破產的人數增加12%。

4. 個人儲蓄率下降

個人儲蓄率反映美國民眾手頭現金是否吃緊，而該比率過去五年來大幅下降。
根據美國經濟分析局(BEA)數據，美國民眾7月平均僅將可支配個人所得的3%存下來，遠低於2021年7月超過9%的個人儲蓄率。
Shilling寫道：「手頭拮据的消費者不斷加深負債，同時也正在掏空自己的小金庫。」

5. 零售商業績承壓

部分大型零售商也陷入困境。Shilling特別指出，沃爾瑪(Walmart)(WMT-US)股價與今年5月高點相比已重挫20%。
沃爾瑪第2季財報顯示，消費者縮減支出的跡象更加明顯。此外，同店銷售成長創六年來最慢，這是衡量現有營收的重要指標，可排除新開門市等因素影響。平均每筆交易金額增幅也大幅放緩至1.1%，遠低於一年前的3.1%。

6. 更多美國人轉向1美元商店

另一方面，1美元商店與其他折扣零售商卻持續蓬勃發展。
Dollar Tree(DLTR-US)上季的同店銷售成長3.7%，Dollar General(DG-US)成長3.5%，Five Below(FIVE-US)則成長14.1%。
Shilling表示，「隨著通膨飆升，消費者這幾年來逐漸轉向這類折扣通路。這波趨勢最初是在2021、2022年疫情後通膨升溫時出現，後來又在川普關稅與伊朗戰爭持續影響下再次加速。」
這些跡象顯示，美國消費市場正在明顯分化：高收入族群仍有能力維持消費，但中低收入家庭面臨生活成本、債務與儲蓄下降等多重壓力，開始轉向折扣零售商。
Shilling因此認為，美國經濟未來12個月陷入衰退的機率仍高達60%至70%，若通膨持續高檔，更可能讓美國面臨衰退與停滯性通膨的雙重風險。
paras_en: Legendary Stanford economist Gary Shilling, famed for accurately predicting the internet bubble and the 2008 housing crisis, warns again that U.S. consumers are repeatedly lighting red flags, suggesting that the U.S. economy could fall into recession within the next year.

Shilling points out that the most concerning area of the U.S. economy is the consumer sector, as high energy costs and potentially elevated interest rates are sending warning signals to American households.
Shilling writes, "Consumers are sending signals that the economy is not all that good. We still believe the probability of a recession in the next year is 60% to 70%."
He adds that a period of stagflation—high inflation, high employment, and weak economic growth—cannot be ruled out.

Stagflation is one of the worst economic scenarios, where growth slows while inflation remains high. This situation is generally considered harder to manage than a typical recession, because in a normal recession the Fed usually stimulates the economy with rate cuts, but high inflation limits the Fed’s ability to do so.

Consumer spending is the main engine of the U.S. economy, accounting for about two-thirds of GDP. High‑income households continue to spend, but the market worries that middle‑to‑low‑income families are feeling the pressure of rising living costs and are beginning to cut back on spending.
Shilling has identified six major consumer warning signs:

1. Retail sales have fallen sharply. Adjusted retail sales data show that Americans cut back on spending in July: according to U.S. Census Bureau data, July retail sales fell 0.6% month‑over‑month, the largest single‑month decline in nearly a year.

Shilling notes that a major factor for the weak July data is the fading effect of federal tax refunds. In recent months, these refunds may not have been spent on discretionary items but rather on higher‑priced, unavoidable goods such as gasoline and groceries.

2. Consumer confidence has plunged. In August, the University of Michigan consumer confidence index fell for the first time in three months, and the index has also slid sharply from its peak in early 2020.

Some of the pessimism is linked to higher inflation expectations. According to a University of Michigan survey, August respondents expected inflation of about 4% over the next year, up from 2% in February, which was before the Iran war erupted.

Additionally, a Primerica Q2 survey found that 71% of middle‑income Americans feel their financial situation is lagging behind rising living costs, and 59% believe the economy will worsen in the next year.
3. Consumer debt pressure is rising. According to Fed data, by the end of Q1, consumer credit debt for households and nonprofit organizations had risen to a record $5.1 trillion.
Primerica’s survey shows that 32% of middle‑income Americans reported an increase in their credit card debt in the last quarter.
The number of bankruptcy filings is also rising. Shilling says that in the 12‑month period ending June, the number of U.S. bankruptcy filings increased by 12%.
4. Personal savings rate has fallen. The personal savings rate reflects how tight Americans’ cash is, and this ratio has dropped sharply over the past five years.
According to the Bureau of Economic Analysis, in July Americans saved only 3% of their disposable personal income on average, far below the 9% personal savings rate in July 2021.
Shilling writes, "Consumers who are strapped for cash are deepening their debt and draining their small coffers."
5. Retail performance is under pressure. Some large retailers are also in trouble. Shilling specifically points out that Walmart (WMT‑US) stock has fallen 20% from its May high this year.

Walmart’s Q2 earnings show even clearer signs of consumers cutting back. In addition, same‑store sales growth is the slowest in six years, a key indicator of existing revenue that excludes the impact of new store openings. The average transaction amount growth also slowed sharply to 1.1%, far below last year’s 3.1%.
6. More Americans are turning to dollar‑store chains. On the other hand, dollar stores and other discount retailers continue to thrive.
Dollar Tree (DLTR‑US) had 3.7% same‑store sales growth last quarter, Dollar General (DG‑US) grew 3.5%, and Five Below (FIVE‑US) grew 14.1%.

Shilling says, "As inflation surged, consumers have gradually turned to these discount channels over the past few years. This trend first emerged in 2021‑2022 after the pandemic‑induced inflation spike, and then accelerated again under Trump tariffs and the ongoing Iran war."

These signs show that the U.S. consumer market is clearly diverging: high‑income groups still have the capacity to maintain spending, while middle‑to‑low‑income families face multiple pressures from living costs, debt, and falling savings, and are turning to discount retailers.

Shilling therefore believes that the probability of a recession in the next 12 months remains high at 60% to 70%, and if inflation stays high, the U.S. could face the dual risk of recession and stagflation.

松川精密在全球擴產及購併效益顯現，松川精密2026年第二季營收及獲利同創新高，稅後純益2.79億元，季增48.41%，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益3.3元，松川2026年上半年稅後純益4.4億元，年增8.33倍，每股純益5.52元。

paras_en: Under the strong push of AI demand, relay manufacturer Matsushita Precision (7788‑TW) has seen its data‑center variable‑frequency drives, server power supplies and UPS, high‑voltage high‑current products start to ramp up significantly from the second half of 2025. At the same time, Matsushita’s revenue has been growing at a rapid pace and reached new highs, with the stock hitting a record intraday high of 347 NT$ this week and closing at 335 NT$ on the 4th, setting a new closing record driven by steady profit improvement.

Matsushita Precision’s global expansion and acquisition benefits are now evident. In Q2 2026, revenue and profit both hit new highs, with net profit after tax of 279 million NT$, a 48.41% quarter‑on‑quarter increase and a turnaround from a loss last year. Earnings per share were 3.30 NT$. For the first half of 2026, net profit after tax reached 440 million NT$, an 8.33‑fold year‑on‑year increase, with earnings per share of 5.52 NT$.

In July, Matsushita’s revenue broke the 900 million NT$ mark, reaching 986 million NT$ for the first time, a 19.09% month‑on‑month increase and a 99.38% year‑on‑year jump. According to the latest earnings announcement, the monthly gross margin stabilized at 30%, net profit after tax was 122 million NT$, a 1.96‑fold year‑on‑year increase, and earnings per share were 1.53 NT$. For January‑July 2026, revenue was 5.103 billion NT$, up 36.88% year‑on‑year, and adding the first‑half report, net profit after tax for January‑July was 593 million NT$, with cumulative earnings per share of 7.05 NT$ for 2026 to date.

Matsushita’s revenue has set a new historical high for three consecutive quarters, pushing the stock price higher through performance and margin improvements. The stock reached an intraday high of 347 NT$ this week and closed at 335 NT$ on the 4th, setting a new closing record. Technical indicators show the price above all moving averages with a bullish alignment, supported by ample trading volume. In the short term, the 5‑day moving average at 320 NT$ serves as support.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉盟立大啖先進封裝商機 周漲11%創歷史新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Mingli Seizes Advanced Packaging Opportunities, Rises 11% to Record High
paras: 自動化設備大廠盟立(2464-TW)近期受惠封測大廠積極擴充先進封裝產能，對自動化需求大增，推升盟立目前在手訂單超過150億元，加上在機器人的布局，獲外界肯定，吸引資金進駐，推升本周股價一度衝上224元、改寫歷史新高價，終場收在211元，周漲11.34%。
盟立今年在SEMICON TAIWAN 2026以 「AI in Motion / AI 機器人新動能」 為主軸，大秀整合先進封裝搬運、智動化系統到人形機器人的全方位解決方案。
盟立7月營收8.63億元，月增6.2%，年增62.1%，創下34個月新高，累計前7月營收48.96億元，年增25.6%。受惠半導體自動化需求大爆發，盟立現階段在手訂單上看150億元，預期2026年全年營收有望站回百億元大關，營運可望顯著優於去年。
盟立本周在買盤加持下衝破前高，週五最高達224元，創下歷史新高，但受高檔獲利了結賣壓影響，終場收在211元，單周仍大漲11.34%，三大法人本周全站買方，外資狂掃11,072張，投信與自營商也分別敲進452張、413張。
paras_en: Automation equipment giant Mingli (2464-TW) recently benefited from major packaging test manufacturers actively expanding advanced packaging capacity, leading to a surge in automation demand, pushing Mingli's current order backlog to over NT$15 billion. Combined with its robotics layout, it has gained external recognition, attracting capital inflows, lifting the stock price this week to as high as NT$224, setting a new all‑time high, and closing at NT$211, up 11.34% for the week.

This year Mingli showcased at SEMICON TAIWAN 2026 with the theme “AI in Motion / AI Robotics New Momentum”, presenting a full‑range solution that integrates advanced packaging handling, intelligent automation systems and humanoid robots.

Mingli posted July revenue of NT$8.63 billion, up 6.2% month‑over‑month and 62.1% year‑over‑year, a 34‑month high. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$48.96 billion, up 25.6% YoY. Benefiting from a boom in semiconductor automation demand, Mingli’s current order backlog stands at NT$15 billion, and it expects full‑year 2026 revenue to return to the NT$100 billion level, with operating performance likely to be significantly better than last year.

This week, backed by buying pressure, Mingli broke its previous high, reaching a peak of NT$224 on Friday, a historic high, but was pulled down by profit‑taking selling pressure at higher levels, closing at NT$211. The stock still surged 11.34% for the week. All three major institutional investors were net buyers this week: foreign investors snapped up 11,072 lots, while investment trusts and proprietary traders bought 452 lots and 413 lots respectively.

items.title_en: E.SUN Financial Group Expands into Life Insurance! Mutual Funds Rush In, Stock Rises 12% This Week, Breaking NT$40 New High
paras: 玉山金控(2884-TW)於 9/1 正式完成與三商美邦人壽之股權交割程序，合併後總資產規模突破 6.6 兆元，一舉躍升為國內第 5 大上市金控，象徵「金控 2.0」新局正式啟動。受此重大合併題材激勵，再加上升息預期，玉山金本周股價上演慶祝行情，成功突破 40 元大關，周五收盤更衝上 43.55 元歷史新高，單周累計漲幅高達 12.39%，目前總股東人數來到 62.2 萬人。
玉山金本周化身飆股，周四一度飆漲 7%，單周漲幅罕見超過 1 成。籌碼面部分，法人買超態度相當明確，本土投信已連續 22 個交易日大力挺進玉山金，累計敲進達 11.6 萬張；外資也共襄盛舉，呈連續3個交易日買超，累計約 2.4 萬張。儘管金控今、明年須再注資人壽 220 億元，但法人對玉山金併購後市仍具強烈信心。
隨著金融版圖大幅擴充，經營團隊人事亦同步到位。玉山金日前董事會決議，由玉山金控總經理陳茂欽接任人壽董事長，原三商壽副董事長許瀞心則出任總經理，展現跨業整合與經營傳承的決心；相關人事案將依法定程序報請主管機關核准後公告。此外，公司預計於 12 月 1 日將三商壽正式更名為「玉山人壽」。
玉山金控指出，本案為合意併購，經雙方董事會與股東臨時會通過，採股份轉換方式辦理，並已於 2026 年 7 月 7 日取得金管會核准。為充實壽險子公司資本並強化後續業務發展基礎，玉山金控董事會同步通過參與三商壽 160 億元現金增資案。
針對市場關注的顧客與員工權益，玉山金控強調，既有保戶權益將獲得 100% 完整保障，原有的保險契約、保障內容及保單效力皆維持不變。包括業務員、客服專線及全台服務據點均照常運作，服務不中斷；未來更將結合傳統業務員團隊與銀行保險通路優勢，提供更完善的保險產品與服務網絡。玉山金控承諾既有內外勤員工於 3 年內全數留用，並持續推動組織整合與人才培育，提供多元發展機會。
玉山金控表示，壽險將成為金控未來的核心成長引擎之一。邁入金控 2.0 階段，公司將發揮銀行、人壽、證券及投信等跨子公司的整合綜效，建構更具競爭力的金融服務平台，為股東及顧客創造永續價值。
paras_en: E.SUN Financial Holding Co. (2884-TW) officially completed the share transfer with SANSUNG MIBAN Life Insurance on September 1, and the combined total assets now exceed NT$6.6 trillion, propelling it to become the fifth‑largest listed financial holding company in Taiwan and marking the launch of a new “Financial Holding 2.0” era. Driven by the merger news and rising‑rate expectations, E.SUN’s stock surged this week, breaking the NT$40 barrier and closing on Friday at a historic high of NT$43.55, a weekly gain of 12.39%. The total number of shareholders has risen to 622,000.

This week E.SUN turned into a rally stock, spiking as much as 7% on Thursday and posting a rare weekly increase of over 10%. On the institutional side, the buying stance is clear: domestic mutual funds have been net buyers for 22 consecutive trading days, accumulating 116,000 lots, while foreign investors have also been net buyers for three straight days, adding about 24,000 lots. Although the group will need to inject NT$22 billion into the life‑insurance arm in 2024‑2025, institutions remain highly confident about E.SUN’s post‑merger outlook.

With the expanded financial footprint, the management team is also being aligned. The board recently resolved that E.SUN Financial Holding’s General Manager Chen Mao‑qin will become chairman of the life‑insurance subsidiary, while former SANSUNG Life vice‑chairman Hsu Jing‑hsin will take over as general manager, demonstrating a commitment to cross‑industry integration and continuity. The related appointments will be submitted to regulators for approval in accordance with legal procedures. The company also plans to rename SANSUNG Life to “E.SUN Life” on December 1.

E.SUN Financial Holding noted that the transaction is a consensual merger approved by both boards and a special shareholders’ meeting, executed via a share‑exchange and approved by the Financial Supervisory Commission on July 7, 2026. To bolster the capital of the life‑insurance subsidiary and strengthen its future business foundation, the board also approved participation in a NT$16 billion cash capital increase for SANSUNG Life.

Addressing market concerns about customer and employee rights, E.SUN emphasized that existing policyholders will receive 100% protection, with all current contracts, coverage terms and policy validity remaining unchanged. Sales agents, call centers and all service locations across Taiwan will continue operating without interruption. Going forward, the group will combine the traditional agent network with its bancassurance channels to offer a more comprehensive suite of insurance products and services. E.SUN also pledged to retain all existing front‑ and back‑office staff for three years and will continue organizational integration and talent development to provide diverse career opportunities.

E.SUN stated that life insurance will become one of the core growth engines for the financial holding company’s future. Entering the Financial Holding 2.0 phase, the firm will leverage synergies across its banking, life‑insurance, securities and asset‑management subsidiaries to build a more competitive financial services platform that creates sustainable value for shareholders and customers.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉輝達RTX Spark預購告急 微星周漲逾11%外資連六買共2.3萬張
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Nvidia RTX Spark Pre‑order Surge, MSI Gains Over 11% This Week as Foreign Investors Buy 23,000 Lots Over Six Sessions
paras: PC品牌微星(2377-TW)受惠輝達攜手台廠打造的 RTX Spark 高階晶片預購熱潮，本周股價表現亮眼。在新品供不應求與追加晶片訂單的消息激勵下，微星 4 日收 161.5 元，周漲幅 11.38%，周成交量72660張，其中外資連續六個交易日累計買進2.3萬張張，投信也呈現連三買累計敲進 1860 張，自營商亦轉為買超 885 張。
輝達預計今年秋季上市的 RTX Spark 系列電腦成為市場少數亮點，有效為下半年受關鍵零組件漲價壓抑的 PC 市況注入強心針。微星名列全球首波合作品牌，首批搭載高階版 N1x 晶片的筆電開放預購後即接近售罄，主要訂單來自台灣、中國大陸與美國客戶，公司已緊急向輝達爭取更多晶片配額以滿足市場缺口。
微星身為首波搶進的品牌廠，除了既有微軟、聯想、惠普等國際大廠加入生態圈外，宏碁與技嘉等同業也陸續跟進導入相關平台。微星在高階市場率先卡位成功，有助於在整體個人電腦消費需求偏弱的環境下，持續透過高附加價值的創新終端產品維持獲利與營運動能。
paras_en: MSI (2377‑TW), a PC brand, benefited from the pre‑order frenzy for Nvidia’s RTX Spark high‑end chip co‑developed with a Taiwanese manufacturer, delivering a standout performance this week. Boosted by news of supply shortages and additional chip orders, MSI closed at NT$161.5 on the 4th, up 11.38% for the week with a volume of 72,660 lots. Foreign investors bought a cumulative 23,000 lots over six consecutive trading days, while investment trusts purchased a total of 1,860 lots over three days, and proprietary traders turned net buyers with 885 lots.

Nvidia expects its RTX Spark series computers, slated for an autumn launch this year, to be one of the few market highlights, injecting a much‑needed boost into the PC sector that has been dampened by rising component costs in the second half of the year. MSI is among the first global partners; after opening pre‑orders for laptops equipped with the high‑end N1x chip, the initial batch nearly sold out, with major orders coming from Taiwan, mainland China and the United States. The company has urgently sought additional chip allocations from Nvidia to close the market gap.

As one of the earliest adopters, MSI joins other international giants such as Microsoft, Lenovo and HP in the ecosystem, while peers like Acer and Gigabyte are also beginning to integrate the platform. MSI’s early foothold in the high‑end market helps it maintain profitability and operational momentum through high‑value innovative products, even as overall personal‑computer consumer demand remains weak.

paras: 聯發科周一(31日)宣布第一次ECB完成定價，其中輝達投資金額達35億美元；SEMICON本周盛大登場，台積電與美超微雙雙揭示新一代水冷散熱藍圖；證交所與富時羅素於周五(4日)公布「臺灣指數系列」及「臺灣高股息指數」2026年第三季度定期審核結果，0050換股名單出爐，以下為本周大事回顧：

輝達砸35億美元認購聯發科ECB 結盟進軍AI工廠、客製化XPU 

聯發科(2454-TW)周一(31日)宣布海外第一次無擔保轉換公司債(ECB)完成訂價，總募資金額達39億美元，折合新台幣超過1,200億元，創下台灣資本市場最高的ECB發行金額，其中，輝達(NVDA-US)投資金額達35億美元，以深化與聯發科的合作夥伴關係。

〈SEMICON〉台積電、AMD齊推新一代水冷板 傳最快明年中量產 

AI晶片功耗持續攀升，散熱已成為關鍵瓶頸。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)與超微(AMD-US)周二(1日)雙雙揭示下一代水冷技術藍圖，同時釋出將封裝與水冷板整合的技術(TIM less)。業界傳出，包括雙鴻(3324-TW)、奇鋐(3017-TW)、健策(3653-TW)及竑騰(7751-TW)等散熱與設備業者均已參與相關技術開發，新一代水冷板方案最快將於明年中進入量產，大搶新一輪AI液冷升級商機。

被動資金準備大搬家！藥華藥晉升臺灣50 世芯-KY轉入中型100 

臺灣證券交易所與富時羅素於周五(4日)正式公布「臺灣指數系列」及「臺灣高股息指數」2026年第三季度定期審核結果。本次最受市場矚目的變動，為生技股藥華藥(6446-TW)因總市值排名躍升至前40名，成功擠進代表台股權值巨頭的「臺灣50指數」成分股，0050 及 006208 皆追蹤該指數；而矽智財(IP)大廠世芯-KY(3661-TW)則遭到刪除，轉入「臺灣中型100指數」。

玉山金完成三商壽交割！躍第5大金控 陳茂欽、許瀞心出任人壽董總 

玉山金控(2884-TW)周二(1日)完成與三商壽之股權交割程序，資產規模逾 6.6 兆元，躍升國內第 5 大上市金控，正式啟動「金控2.0」新局。隨著版圖擴充，高層人事同步發布，由玉山金控總經理陳茂欽接任人壽董事長，原三商壽副董事長許瀞心出任總經理，展現跨業整合與經營傳承的決心。本次併購全面保障保戶權益與全體員工留用，公司預計於12月1日更名為「玉山人壽」，續寫金融新頁。

〈勞動基金績效〉7月大虧2463.7億！新制勞退失血千億 前7月平均分紅10.29萬「縮水」1.3萬 

勞動基金運用局周二(1日)公布最新績效，受全球股市7月劇烈修正、台股單月重挫逾3000點拖累，勞動基金297月單月虧損2463.7億元。今年截至7月底止，整體勞動基金累計收益數降至1兆9560億元，跌破2兆元大關，累計收益率為25.03%，總規模達9兆826億元。相較6月底新制勞退累積收益創下歷史新高，平均每位勞工帳面分紅達 11.6萬元，本次縮水約1.31萬元。

8月台灣製造業PMI連11個月擴張 並創5年來新高 

中華經濟研究院周二(1日)公布8月台灣製造業PMI指數續揚1.0個百分點至62.5%，不僅連續第11個月擴張，也創2021年8月以來新高；未來六個月展望指數則是連8個月維持在60.0%以上。
paras_en: MediaTek announced on Monday (the 31st) that its first unsecured convertible bond (ECB) overseas has been priced, raising a total of $3.9 billion (over NT$1.2 trillion), the largest ECB issuance in Taiwan’s capital markets. Nvidia (NVDA-US) is investing $3.5 billion, deepening its partnership with MediaTek.
Nvidia is pouring $3.5 billion into MediaTek’s ECB, forging an alliance to push into AI factories and custom XPU solutions.

At SEMICON this week, TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) unveiled next‑generation water‑cooling plate technology, with a TIM‑less integration of package and cooling plate. Industry players such as Double‑Hong (3324‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW), Jiances (3653‑TW) and Hongteng (7751‑TW) are already involved in development. The new water‑cooling solution could enter mass production by mid‑next year, sparking a fresh wave of AI liquid‑cooling opportunities.

Passive funds are on the move. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and FTSE Russell released the Q3 2026 periodic review results for the Taiwan Index Series and Taiwan High‑Dividend Index. The most notable change is biotech firm YaoHua Pharma (6446‑TW) climbing into the top‑40 market‑cap ranking and gaining entry to the Taiwan 50 Index, tracked by ETFs 0050 and 006208. Conversely, IP giant SiChin‑KY (3661‑TW) was removed from the Taiwan 50 and shifted to the Taiwan Mid‑Cap 100 Index.

E.Sun Financial (2884‑TW) completed the share‑transfer with SANSUNG Life on Tuesday (the 1st), bringing its assets to over NT$6.6 trillion and propelling it to the fifth‑largest listed financial holding company in Taiwan. The group launched a “Financial Holding 2.0” strategy. E.Sun CEO Chen Mao‑qin will become chairman of the life‑insurance subsidiary, while former SANSUNG Life vice‑chairperson Hsu Jing‑hsin will serve as its general manager. The merger fully protects policyholders and retains staff, and the company plans to rename itself E.Sun Life on Dec 1.

The Labor Fund reported a massive July loss of NT$246.37 billion, driven by a sharp global market correction and a single‑month drop of over 3,000 points in the Taiwan index. As of the end of July, the fund’s cumulative net assets fell to NT$1.956 trillion, slipping below the NT$2 trillion threshold, with a cumulative return of 25.03% on a total scale of NT$9.826 trillion. Under the new pension scheme, average per‑worker accrued dividends peaked at NT$116,000, but this period saw a shrinkage of about NT$13,100 per worker.

Taiwan’s manufacturing PMI rose another point in August to 62.5, marking the 11th consecutive month of expansion and the highest level since August 2021. The six‑month forward outlook index has stayed above 60 for eight straight months.

paras_en: Largan Precision (3008-TW), a key supplier in Apple’s optical component supply chain, actively investing in AI-enabled photonic communication components, announced its latest revenue figures on the 5th. In August 2026, Largan’s revenue reached 5.012 billion NTD, a 2.76% month‑on‑month increase but a 16.23% year‑on‑year decline. From January to August 2026, total revenue was 39.093 billion NTD, up 3.71% YoY. The company remains a key customer‑side pull‑in point in Q3, while also expanding its photonic communication product manufacturing and aggressively acquiring land.

In August 2026, Largan’s revenue of 5.012 billion NTD was largely driven by 10‑million‑pixel products, which accounted for roughly 60‑70% of sales. 20‑million‑pixel products made up 10‑20%, 8‑million‑pixel products 0‑10%, and 5‑million‑pixel products 20‑30%.

Over the past three months, Largan has invested in four land purchases in Taichung’s industrial and precision machinery zones. The acquisitions mainly aim to consolidate plant sites and prepare for future expansions. The largest investment, totaling 3.08 billion NTD, involved buying 6,292.14 pings of land at 513‑11 and 513‑12 in the Nantun District of Taichung, and 7,054.01 pings of buildings at 8 and 10 Jingke Road, also in Nantun.

Largan’s first‑half 2026 financial report showed revenue of 29.209 billion NTD, a gross margin of 49.41%, net profit of 10.793 billion NTD, and earnings per share of 8.235 NTD. In July 2026, the company’s net profit was 1.826 billion NTD, up 6.97% YoY, with an EPS of 1.394 NTD. Including the first‑half results, the cumulative EPS from January to July reached 9.629 NTD.
On the 4th, Largan’s stock closed at 7,400 NTD, up 250 NTD or 3.5% from the previous day, with trading volume reduced to 1,424 shares.
